desc: Motion list of the character animation viewer (preview of a unit's sprite motions, prev/next browsing; screen object field +0x19170 = current row id). NOT the char->anm mapping: which anm file is shown comes from the character; this table only lists which animation numbers to cycle through. Groups are contiguous id ranges ended by a terminator row (anim_base=-1); the group used per character is hard-coded in the exe (see id). A new humanoid unit automatically uses the generic list 100..125; a new monster family would need an exe patch (or reuse an existing family id).

fields.name: anim_base
fields.desc: animation number inside the unit anm file; the viewer plays anim_base+1 (front) or anim_base+7 (back/flipped view). Values 10, 1000..1110 (idle/walk/attack...), 1500..1550, 2000..2070, 4000..4030. -1 = end of list

fields.name: freeze_frame
fields.desc: -1 = play normally (speed 1.0); >=0 = animation paused (speed 0) at this frame (exe 0x140456f90 -> 0x1402f2f20 sets time=frame<<16). Observed 0..54
